summary: PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that CEO Zhijun Pan resigned effective September 16, 2026, and the board appointed Lei Liu, age 42, as CEO the same day. Pan stays on as director and chairman; Liu receives US$1,280 monthly. Both executive officer and indemnification agreements were executed and filed as Exhibit 10.1, with a press release at Exhibit 99.1. The abrupt CEO change, though framed as personal work commitments with no disagreement, removes the chairman's dual operating role. Watch for follow-on disclosures on strategy, control, and any related-party transactions.
